sections.heading: Planning your Plantation Creek @ Tengah interior
sections.text:
Tengah is a new town that is still being built out, which has a practical effect on renovation: you may be among the earlier households in a landscape of new roads and, over time, new amenities, and the interior still has to work on day one. That usually means serious built-in storage — a fitted kitchen, full-height wardrobes, an entry cabinet, and a living-room joinery wall — rather than a temporary arrangement of loose furniture while you “see how the town develops”. Maison specifies that carpentry professionally, not as IKEA-style furniture, and we will draw it from your approved plan only. No official floor plan is on file, so typologies are not listed.

Garden Waterfront I & II @ Tengah and Plantation Verge are the other Tengah pages in this batch and are also unconfirmed for keys; do not copy a date from one page to another. Keat Hong Grange, already live in Choa Chu Kang, and Heart of Yew Tee are nearby western links. We will not invent walking times to any present or future MRT station, and we will not assign a water view from the name “Creek”.

After keys, inspect defects and obtain the HDB renovation permit before fabrication. A moderate carpentry scope is often planned at six to ten weeks on site after approvals, as an editorial figure only. WhatsApp Maison with your approved plan and any key letter you have. We are not affiliated with HDB.
